content: Hewaappe guyyiyan, saluwan wolqqaama mallay beetteedda. Awaa mayyeedda itti mishiratta, agenaa bolla eqqeeddawunna, tammanne laa77u xoolinttiyaa akililiyaa bare huuphiyan wotheeddawunna hewaan de7aw.
He mishiratta shahaara; izo yeluwaa oythay, un77ethina waassaaddu.
Hara itti wolqqaama mallay saluwan beetteedda. Tammu kaciyaanna de7iyaa laappu huuphiyan akililiyaa wotheedda itti wolqqaama zo7o dawi de7ee.
He dawi bare dufiiyan heezzentho kushe xoolinttiyaa saluwaappe dafiide, sa7an oleedda. He dawi yeletti wodhdhosaannakka na7aa maanaw yelana haniyaa mishiratti sinthan eqqeedda.
Mishiratta attuma na7aa, Ayihuda gidenna asaa ubbaa birataa xam77aan mooddanawaa yelaaddu. Shin na7ay Xoossaakkonne A araataakko, pude ellekka aketteedda.
Mishiratta itti sha77anne laa77u xeetanne usuppun tammu gallassaw miziiddenne ushshiidde wothanaw Xoossay giigissi wotheedda sa7aa bazzuwaa baqataaddu.
Hewaappe guyyiyan, saluwan olay denddeedda. Mikaa7eeli bare kiitanchchatuwaanna ittippe dawiyaa oletteedda; dawiikka bare kiitanchchatuwanna gidiide, zaari oletteedda.
Shin dawi xoonettina dawiyaasinne A kiitanchchatuwaassi saluwan sa7ay dhayeedda.
Woliqqaama dawi, xalahiyaa kaappuwaa woy Seexaanaa giyaawe, beni shooshshay, alamiyaa ubbaa balethiyaawe oletteedda; I bare kiitanchchatuwanna ittippe duge sa7aw oletteedda.
Hewaappe guyyiyan, taani saluwaappe hawaadan yaagiyaa kooshshaa sisaaddi;
Qassi dawi barena duge sa7aa oleeddawaa be7eeddawaappe guyyiyan, he attuma na7aa yeleedda mishiratto yederssuwaa doommeedda.
Mishiratto shooshshay qohenna mala, heezzu laythaanne baggaa maadenne ushaadde iza naagettiyasaa bazzuwaa paallaade baana mala, laa77u wolqqaama argganthaa qefii iziw imetteedda.
Hewaappe guyyiyan, mishiratto di7uu di77iide afana mala, shooshshay shaafaa haathaa keena haathaa bare doonaappe mishiratti geeduwan gusseedda.
Shin biittay mishiratto maaddeedda; biittay bare doonaa dooyyiide, dawiyaa doonaappe keseedda haathaa mitti aggeedda.
Dawi mishirattiw darissi hanqqettiide, izi zerethaa Xoossaa azazuwaa naagiyaa ubbatuwaanne Yesuusi qonccisseedda tumu ammanettiyaawantta olanaw,
biide abbaa doonan de7iyaa shafiyaan eqqeedda.
